prose: I was invited back to P.A.T. Life Podcast and this time I brought my brilliant friend Dylan Saccoccio.

From P.A.T. Life: Welcome back! It was an honor to have on Chance Garton and Dylan Saccoccio, as we cover a plethora of topics. Chance is the host of innerverse podcast, as well as a sound healer. Dylan is the author of the three part series "Spirit Whirled", which meticulously breaks the spell that all of us are currently hexed by to some degree or another. We dive into the correlation and relationship of religions, cultures, and tribes and the linguistic parallels and similarities (green language, language of the birds) between them. We cover masculine and feminine energy as it relates to nature, and how modern entertainment (to hold the mind) has thwarted the natural balance of our own masculine and feminine energies. We break down the etymology of words and symbols, the destructive nature of Hollywood and the nefarious actions that manipulate and deceive those within, as well as out of, the beast of entertainment, and much more.

We cover all of these topics in order to get to the heart of the matter: Your energy is yours, and whether you choose to embrace it or not is up to you. If you don't, others will. Take charge of your life, put out the energy in life that you want to see (hopefully for the betterment of nature and its perfection), and thrive.
